newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine C Bank not seen quoting rates -traders.
newsitem.headline: Philippine C Bank not seen quoting rates -traders.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank was not seen quoting its peso-dollar exchange rate on Friday despite the sharp fall in the peso, traders said.
"The Central Bank is not yet quoting in the market," one senior trader at a foreign bank said.
The Central Bank usually gives its bid-and-offer quote as guideposts to the foreign exchange market.
The Philippine Central Bank earlier said "it will allow the peso to move within a new wider range consistent with significantly changed market conditions."
The bank did not specify the range.
The statement triggered a sharp depreciation of the peso in early trade, prompting the Bankers Association of the Philippines to temporarily suspend trading.
